nome_en: Submarine Fortress Lair, Garde Fifth Floor
nome_jp: 我竜塔第五層 海底鬼面城
testo:
(When you play this galaxy castle, shieldify it face up. When this card would leave your shield zone face up, put it into your graveyard instead.)
■ When you put this galaxy castle into your shield zone face up, choose up to 2 of your opponent's creatures and return them to their owner's hand.
testo_jp:
（G城は実行したら、表向きでシールド化される。このカードが表向きで自分のシールドゾーンを離れる時、かわりに墓地に置く）
■ この城が表向きで自分のシールドゾーンに置かれた時、相手のクリーチャーを2体まで選び、持ち主の手札に戻す。
